description: Orange spiral "nine" suspended in center of paper, with the base tip of the "nine" curving to the right. Red strokes on either side of the "nine." Inside the spiral "o" of the "nine," blue, red, orange and white combine. This artwork has *Untitled (Abstraction Blue Lines)*, 1970s (cat. no. 1682) on the back.
